entities.name: Munda
entities.description: Kor known as The Spider for his skill with ropes; squad leader of the Zendikari allied forces appointed by Gideon Jura.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: Planeswalker who appointed Munda squad leader.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: Eldrazi titan trapped and later released.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: Eldrazi titan woken by Ob Nixilis.

entities.name: Aligned Hedron Network
entities.description: Hedrons the Kor arranged with ropes to trap Ulamog.

events.summary: Munda chases the runaway goblin Pili, meets Nissa Revane and helps her defeat Eldrazi, and persuades the goblins to join the allied forces.
events.quote: He found Pili and an army of other goblins, which he persuaded to join the allied forces at Sky Rock .

events.summary: After high losses at Sea Gate, Munda convinces Gideon to retreat.
Munda coordinates the Kor to arrange the Aligned Hedron Network to trap Ulamog.
events.quote: Munda coordinated the Kor, which salvaged and arranged the Aligned Hedron Network with ropes in order to trap Ulamog .

events.summary: Ob Nixilis releases Ulamog and wakes Kozilek; Munda rallies to General Tazri.

relations.quote: Munda was appointed by Gideon Jura as a squad leader of the Zendikari allied forces
